This is an example website for testing jrnl. Pages and posts are written in
markdown format, and paragraphs are just lines of text.

## Header 2

Below is an unordered list,

* Item 1

Markdown also supports code blocks either indented with four spaces, or via a
fenced code block,

    $ jrnl init
    $ jrnl page -l page About

It also supprts inline code, `jrnl post "Hello, world"`.
